 Yaxel Lendeborg flirts with triple-double Saturday against Suns 
 by Chris Schommer | Warriors Correspondent | Sun, Oct 25th 2026, 4:28pm EDT 
 Yaxel Lendeborg flirted with a triple-double for the Warriors Saturday night, dishing out five assists, grabbing nine rebounds, and scoring 26 points (9-19 FG, 6-11 3PT, 2-3 FT) while also blocking one shot in a 131-122 loss to the Suns. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Lendeborg has been impactful on both ends of the floor to begin the season, finishing with two or more assists, three or more rebounds, and 12 or more points in each of the first three contests. The rookie offers head coach Steve Kerr one of the few stable options as part of a banged-up Warriors lineup early on, averaging 18.7 points, 1.3 steals, 4.3 assists, and 8.3 rebounds per game while posting a 21.2% usage rate so far this season.
